integrity: Exact algebraic-closure proof, two nondegenerate local Hessian certificates, and standalone executable finite-field cross-check; no infinite assertion rests solely on finite enumeration.
scientific_limitations: Specific coefficientwise integral octic model in characteristic five; no assertion for arbitrary integral models.
No determination of semistable reduction or resolution of the associated double-octic threefold.
Historical modular-invariant literature may contain an equivalent formulation; independent scientific validation has not been performed.
title: Ninety-six rational ordinary nodes on the characteristic-five Maschke octic
